# 1042. Flower Planting With No Adjacent

## Solution 1 (time O(m+n), space O(m+n))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def gardenNoAdj(self, n, paths):
        """
        :type n: int
        :type paths: List[List[int]]
        :rtype: List[int]
        """
        g = [[] for i in range(n)]
        for path in paths:
            g[path[0] - 1].append(path[1] - 1)
            g[path[1] - 1].append(path[0] - 1)
        ans = [0] * n
        for i in range(n):
            c = [False] * 5
            for v in g[i]:
                c[ans[v]] = True
            for j in range(1, 5):
                if not c[j]:
                    ans[i] = j
                    break
        return ans
```
